result.description:
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented ICT Systems Test Engineer to join our team and play a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of our technology systems. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing and executing comprehensive test strategies, identifying defects, and working collaboratively with development and infrastructure teams to deliver robust, high-quality solutions. This role suits a methodical and analytical professional with a strong technical background in software and systems testing, a commitment to quality assurance best practices, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, agile environment.
## Key Responsibilities
- Specify, develop, and execute detailed test plans, test scripts, and test cases to validate the behaviour, functionality, and integrity of ICT systems across multiple platforms and environments.
- Identify, diagnose, and document functionality errors and faults in systems and programming code within established testing protocols, quality standards, and compliance guidelines to ensure systems perform to specification.
- Design and conduct regression, integration, performance, and user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure new and updated systems meet defined requirements and business needs.
- Utilise automated test software and frameworks to streamline testing processes, improve test coverage, and increase efficiency across the software development lifecycle.
- Produce clear and comprehensive defect reports, test summary reports, and related quality assurance documentation, ensuring traceability from requirements through to test outcomes.
- Perform systems architecture reviews and assessments, evaluating current and future hardware and software configurations, and contributing recommendations to inform strategic technical direction.
- Collaborate closely with software developers, business analysts, and project managers to clarify requirements, resolve defects, and support timely delivery of system releases.
- Create, review, and maintain technical documentation including procedural guides, operational manuals, instructional materials, technical specifications, and maintenance inventory records.
- Analyse test results and defect trends to identify recurring issues, recommend process improvements, and support continuous quality improvement initiatives across the organisation.
- Participate in agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives, contributing a quality assurance perspective throughout the development cycle.
- Assess risks associated with system changes and releases, providing input into risk mitigation strategies and supporting informed decision-making across project and operational teams.
- Support the evaluation, selection, and implementation of testing tools, methodologies, and frameworks to ensure the organisation's testing capabilities remain current and effective.
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- A bachelor's degree or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
- Demonstrated experience in ICT systems testing, quality assurance, or a closely related technical role, with a solid understanding of the software development and systems engineering lifecycle.
- Proficiency in writing and executing test plans, test cases, and test scripts across functional, non-functional, and regression testing scenarios.
- Hands-on experience with test automation tools and frameworks such as Selenium, Cypress, JUnit, TestNG, or comparable technologies.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose complex system faults and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Experience producing high-quality technical documentation, including test reports, defect logs, operational guides, and system specifications.
- Familiarity with agile and DevOps methodologies and the ability to integrate quality assurance activities into iterative development workflows.
- Solid understanding of systems architecture, network infrastructure, and software integration concepts relevant to enterprise ICT environments.
- Competency with defect tracking and test management tools such as JIRA, Azure DevOps, Zephyr, or similar platforms.
- Excellent communication, collaboration, and organisational skills, with a strong commitment to delivering quality outcomes within agreed timeframes.
## Preferred Qualifications
- ISTQB certification (Foundation Level or above) or an equivalent recognised qualification in software testing or quality assurance.
- Experience working in regulated industries or environments with strict compliance, security, or governance requirements, such as government, finance, or healthcare.
- Exposure to performance and load testing tools such as Apache JMeter, LoadRunner, or Gatling.
- Familiarity with cybersecurity testing principles, including vulnerability assessments and secure coding practices.
- Experience with cloud-based environments and platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud, and an understanding of how they impact testing strategies.
- Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and associated tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or Bamboo.
- A postgraduate qualification or additional certifications in project management, IT governance, or related fields, such as ITIL or PRINCE2, would be highly regarded.
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative, inclusive, and forward-thinking team that values technical excellence and continuous improvement, where your contributions directly shape the quality of systems used across the organisation.
- Access ongoing professional development opportunities, including support for industry certifications, training programmes, and attendance at relevant conferences and events.
- Enjoy a flexible working environment with options for hybrid work arrangements, supporting a healthy work-life balance without compromising on career growth.
- Work on complex, large-scale ICT projects that offer genuine variety and the opportunity to deepen your expertise across diverse technologies and industries.
- Receive a competitive remuneration package with a clear pathway for career progression within a growing organisation that invests in its people.
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

result.description:
At Russells Darwin Transport, we are currently looking for skilled and experienced Diesel Motor Mechanics to join our team.

The role will include but is not limited to: 

* Diagnose mechanical and electrical faults using diagnostic tools scanners and technical manuals; provide clear repair recommendations and cost estimates. 
* Perform routine servicing and preventative maintenance, including oil and filter changes, fluid checks, brake inspections, and scheduled servicing to manufacturer and company standards. 
* Carry out repairs, rebuilds and component replacements on engines, transmissions, drivetrains, hydraulic and braking systems using hand and power tools. 
* Test completed repairs by road testing or operating equipment to verify fault resolution and performance. 
* Maintain accurate service records, job cards and compliance documentation in the workshop management system. 
* Ensure all repairs and maintenance comply with relevant transport legislation, manufacturer specifications and WHS requirements. 
* Participate in fault finding, root cause analysis and corrective action processes to reduce repeat failures. 
* Assist with workshop housekeeping, tool maintenance and control of parts inventory to support efficient operations. 
* Provide technical guidance to apprentices and other workshop staff as required. 
* Promote a strong safety culture: follow safe work procedures, use personal protective equipment and report hazards or incidents immediately. 

Key Competencies: 

* Trade qualification: Certificate III in Heavy Automotive Mechanical Technology (or equivalent) or recognised trade qualification in diesel mechanics. Relevant qualification (preferred) in addition to relevant mechanical experience. 
* For applicants without a relevant diesel mechanical qualification, additional work experience (at least 3-5 years) would be required. 
* Proven fault finding and diagnostic skills for compression ignition engines, fuel injection systems, hydraulics and vehicle electrical systems. 
* Proficiency with digital diagnostic software, technical manuals and digital record keeping. 
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to provide practical, cost-effective repair solutions. 
* Good communication skills, able to convey technical information clearly to managers, operators and customers. 
* High attention to detail and commitment to maintain accurate records. 
* Physically fit and able to safely handle heavy components and work in varied workshop conditions. 
* Team player with a positive attitude and willingness to support continuous improvement initiatives 
* Previous experience in vehicle fit-out, transport, mining or heavy plant industries is desirable 
* Experience supervising apprentices or trainees is desirable. 
* Relevant licences or tickets (e.g. forklift licence, elevated work platform) and work at heights / confined spaces training is desirable. 
* Current WA driver’s licence is desirable. 

Salary: $34 - $45 per hour 

If this exciting opportunity to join the team at Russel Transport has sparked your interest, please click ‘Apply Now’!

Requirements

• Minimum 3 years of relevant experience
• Certificate III in Light Vehicle Mechanical Technology or equivalent
• Strong knowledge of vehicle mechanical systems, engines, transmissions, steering, suspension, and braking systems

This is a role at WPP Media which is part of the WPP network.

About WPP Media

WPP Media is the leading global media investment management company serving as the parent to WPP media agencies including Mindshare, EssenceMediacom, Wavemaker, Choreograph and GOAT. With 1,000+ people based across Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Adelaide and Perth, WPP Media’s primary purpose is to maximize performance of WPP’s agencies by operating as leader and collaborator in trading, content creation, sports, digital, finance, proprietary tool development and other business-critical capabilities. WPP Media’s focus is to deliver unrivalled advantage to its clients, stakeholders, and people. Combined with WPP Media’s global scale, our media investment decisions—guided by brand safety, leading privacy principles and premium relationships— represent 1 out of 3 ads in the global marketplace. Through modern investment services, we put money against goals that move businesses forward.

Implementation & Activation

The Implementation & Activation team is responsible for delivering best-in-class media planning and buying for our award-winning agency brands. 

The scope of the Implementation & Activation team covers all media channels and touchpoints, with a focus on delivering omnichannel media plans in each of our client patches and brands. Sitting centrally alongside our Implementation & Activation team is our Centre of Excellence, housing the Media Operations team and Craft Heads. 

With our collective industry expertise, we navigate the ever-changing media landscape efficiently and effectively, fuelling growth for the brands we work with. Our commitment to transparency and accountability drives best-in-class results consistently, leveraging our exceptional media relationships to keep our finger on the pulse of emerging opportunities.

Role Outline

The Implementation & Activation Director is a leadership role, overseeing operational excellence and responsible for all day-to-day output that delivers effective campaigns, ensuring best-in-class consistent implementation, optimisation, and reporting. Working very closely with your Head Of and Client Partner, you will produce best-in-class solutions, offer unparalleled service and deliver against targets.

CLIENTS

Regularly meet with vendors and partners to drive your client's agenda, creating opportunities for your team members to get involved and engage.
Focus on building our outstanding client service reputation
Robust understanding of the in-scope services of your clients and the process for completing work above and beyond
Provide innovative strategic insights by acting as an expert on the client's business, industry and competitors.

PRODUCT

When required, a strict adherence to activation commitments that have client contract association. 
Lead the construction and presentation of effective and future facing Implementation plans and negotiation strategies that are grounded in strategic priorities and data-led optimisation recommendations. 
Exceptional knowledge of the media landscape, able to confidently articulate and train others on media principles and the how each media touchpoint can fuel growth for clients. 
Identify and lead product innovation opportunities for your clients.
Collaborate closely with internal WPP Media teams to ensure you can clearly articulate the benefits of their inclusion, with a focus on converting growth opportunities that can transform outcomes.
Seek to find, communicate and implement improvements in all aspects of the role.
Responsible for the overall delivery of client campaigns & KPIs, with flawless accuracy.
Support the state and national craft leaders in identifying and implementing tools, technology, data, and automation solutions through the organisation, and then ensuring maximum adoption of best practice.

PEOPLE
Motivate and empower team to achieve individual, team and organisational goals. 
Conduct fortnightly 1:1s, annual Career Conversations and Performance Reviews with direct reports.
Liaise with the People Team to resolve any team disputes to ensure a safe and productive team environment. 
Continuously champion company values to build strong and trusted connections, solution-oriented perspectives and demonstrate genuine care for collective team success.
Foster knowledge sharing, and continuous learning around point of views, trends, and relevant skills to continue nurturing a high-performing team.

GROWTH & MARKETING
Identify, collate and showcase examples of great work from within the team, both internally and externally.
Build the agency’s reputation by contributing to entries for awards and competitions and by contributing to industry thought leadership.
Actively contribute to new business development and pitching as needed.

REQUIRED CAPABILITIES
You feel empowered to bring your authentic self to work, and contribute to great teamwork, knowing your individual ideas and thoughts will be welcome.

Results driven with the ability to identify and clearly articulate what’s working and why. 
Problem solving mentality. Attention to detail. Clear communicator.

?

Sous Chef

• Assist the Head Chef in menu planning, recipe creation, and food preparation.

• Oversee and supervise kitchen staff to ensure smooth kitchen operations.

• Manage the preparation and cooking of food in all sections of the kitchen.

• Prepare and cook a diverse range of dishes, upholding stringent quality, portion size, presentation, and food safety standards.

• Maintain high standards of food hygiene and safety.

• Monitor inventory and order stock as necessary.

• Manage kitchen operations in the absence of the Head Chef.

• Train and mentor junior kitchen staff.

• Ensure that dishes are prepared and presented according to the restaurant’s standards.

• Communicate effectively with the front-of-house team to ensure efficient service.

Qualifications / Attributes

• Must hold a Certificate IV in Commercial Cookery, or at least three (3) years of relevant work experience may substitute for the formal qualification.

• Must possess at least one (1) year of relevant work experience as a Sous Chef, Chef de Partie, or in a similar commercial kitchen role.

• Thorough understanding of food safety, HACCP, workplace health and safety, and kitchen hygiene standards.

• Experience managing food preparation across multiple kitchen sections.

• Strong organisational and time management skills with the ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

• High attention to detail with a commitment to quality, consistency, and presentation.

• Passion for hospitality and delivering exceptional dining experiences.

?
